h1: A cylinder thermal cut-out keeps operating
title: A cylinder thermal cut-out keeps operating | G3 Cylinder Help
description: Understand a cylinder thermal cut-out keeps operating. Distinguish the symptom, gather useful details and arrange competent cylinder assessment in London.
answer: A cut-out is a safety device. Repeated operation needs investigation of the heating and temperature-control fault before any reset or replacement.

sections.heading: What this symptom can mean
paragraphs: The protective device is separate from routine temperature regulation. Bypassing it removes a safety layer. A concealed reset button is not a universal homeowner action, particularly when overheating or discharge has occurred.

sections.heading: Information to gather safely
paragraphs: Report the pattern and any very hot delivery or relief discharge. Follow the specific user safety instructions and arrange competent attention; do not treat a temporary restart as proof the cause is resolved.

sections.heading: How the enquiry becomes an investigation
paragraphs: The cylinder make, full model and heating arrangement should be identified first. The same visible symptom can arise from different causes, and a relief device may be protecting the system rather than creating the original problem. Component testing and any repair belong to a person competent for the work.

sections.heading: Discuss the appropriate next step
paragraphs: Call 020 7205 4433 with the postcode, symptom history and any previous service findings. The enquiry establishes the proposed assessment and availability. Do not use this guide as a substitute for the actual appliance safety instructions or an on-site diagnosis.

faqs.question: Can a thermal cut-out be bypassed if it keeps stopping hot water?
faqs.answer: No. Never bypass thermal protection; its repeated operation needs the underlying control or heating fault investigated by a competent person.
